categories.main_business_segments: KEN Holding Co., Ltd primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-grade, high-performance professional electric tools. Its product portfolio includes electric drills, electric wrenches, electric hammers, angle grinders, polishers, cutting machines, and related accessories. The company serves industrial manufacturing, construction, and home improvement sectors with both domestic and international sales channels.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced brushless motor technology, lithium battery integration, and high-voltage AC brushless control technologies. It continuously upgrades its 12V, 16V, 20V, and develops 40V voltage platforms to enhance tool performance, safety, and durability. Manufacturing incorporates precision engineering for power tools with a focus on innovation in motor control algorithms and battery safety design.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include industrial manufacturers, construction companies, and professional users requiring durable and efficient electric tools. The company also targets the home improvement (DIY) market domestically. Internationally, it serves markets in Southeast Asia, Russia, the Middle East, India, Turkey, and other regions through direct sales and distributors.
categories.geographic_coverage: KEN Holding operates mainly in China with headquarters in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Zhejiang, Hong Kong, Thailand, and the British Virgin Islands. Its sales cover domestic Chinese markets and international markets including Southeast Asia, Russia, Middle East, India, Turkey, Malaysia, and Korea. The company actively participates in global trade fairs to expand its international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electric tools supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of professional-grade electric tools and components. It also engages in downstream activities through brand marketing, distribution, and direct sales to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening proprietary brand development, advancing brushless motor and lithium battery technologies, and expanding high-voltage AC brushless tool platforms. The company invests heavily in R&D to improve product efficiency, safety, and user experience, while actively participating in national standards development. It also pursues industrial automation and intelligent manufacturing as future growth areas.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of electric tools and accessories under the company’s own brand and ODM arrangements. Sales channels include domestic distributors (dealer model) and direct export sales internationally. The company also earns investment income from financial products and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: KEN Holding is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of high-end professional electric tools in China, competing with both domestic and international brands. The industry is highly competitive with many small-scale low-end producers, but KEN focuses on mid-to-high-end markets with advanced technology and brand strength to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 437 million, a 12.77% decline from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 19.26 million. The company’s total assets were around RMB 1.28 billion. Despite recent revenue and profit declines due to market and exchange rate pressures, the company maintains a solid asset base and continues investing in R&D and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: KEN Holding emphasizes its brand as a domestic alternative to imported professional electric tools, focusing on product quality, durability, and after-sales service. Its competitive edge lies in advanced brushless motor technology, lithium battery integration, and tailored solutions for professional industrial users. The company leverages extensive distributor networks and e-commerce platforms to provide responsive market service and continuously upgrades product lines to meet evolving customer demands.
